items.title: Coordinated Mixed-Precision KV Cache Quantization for Efficient LLM-based Multi-agent Systems
items.summary_1line: LLM-based multi-agent systems solve complex tasks through collaboration, but their growing, simultaneously resident key-value (KV) caches create a memory bottleneck. Applying single-model quantization policies indepen...
items.editor_note: 팀의 메모리 비용을 짚는다: 모든 에이전트의 KV 캐시가 동시에 상주한다는 점이다.

items.title: WorkflowArena: Benchmarking Executable Workflow Orchestration in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
items.summary_1line: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed as multi-agent systems rather than as a standalone model operating within a single context. Recent agent harnesses allow the model to instantiate worker agents and...
items.why_it_matters: Matches feed focus: agent, harness, evaluation.
items.editor_note: 워커 에이전트를 생성하는 하니스를 실행 가능한 워크플로 오케스트레이션 기준으로 평가한다.

items.title: On Private Knowledge Retrieval and Private Inference for secure multi-agent systems
items.summary_1line: Multi-agent systems provide a convenient framework for the massive deployment of agents based on Large Language Models (LLMs). It provides a sound framework where agents can interact with existing software to perform...
items.editor_note: 의제에 프라이버시를 추가한다: 에이전트 간 비공개 검색과 추론을 다룬다.

items.title: CoLFA: Collaboration-Guided Lightweight Failure Attribution for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
items.summary_1line: Failure attribution in multi-agent systems requires tracing error formation to identify the decisive error step and the responsible agent. However, agents' division of work and information exchange lead to Interleaved...
items.editor_note: 첫 번째 실패 귀인 사례: 결정적인 오류 단계와 그 뒤에 있는 에이전트를 찾아낸다.

items.title: Show HN: AgentLeak – open-source privacy testing for multi-agent LLM systems
items.summary_1line: Show HN: AgentLeak – open-source privacy testing for multi-agent LLM systems
items.editor_note: 이 스레드의 유일한 오픈소스 도구: 멀티 에이전트 시스템의 프라이버시 유출 테스트.

items.title: Securing Multi-Agent Systems by Design
items.summary_1line: Multi-agent systems solve complex tasks by decomposing them into subtasks, delegating the subtasks to agents, and aggregating the agents' responses using an aggregation rule. Malicious agents can manipulate the final...
items.editor_note: 에이전트 답변을 취합하는 단계를 악의적인 에이전트가 공격하는 지점으로 본다.

items.title: Presentation: Scaling LLM-Based Ranking Systems for Latency-Critical Search & Recommendation Workloads
items.summary_1line: Sundara Raman Ramachandran shares how LinkedIn productionizes LLM ranking under strict P99 latency SLAs. He discusses distilling a 7B model down to 400M parameters, compressing job contexts into single-token embedding...
items.editor_note: 관련성은 낮음: P99 레이턴시 제약 아래의 프로덕션 LLM 랭킹을 다루며 멀티 에이전트 시스템은 아니다.

items.title: TRACE-MAS: Diagnosing and Repairing Collaboration Failures in Multi-Agent Systems
items.summary_1line: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) rely on not only individual agent behaviors but also the interactions that connect agents, including message exchanges and task dependencies. Existing MAS safeguards mainly perform...
items.editor_note: 협업 실패를 진단하는 데서 나아가 이를 복구하는 단계로 넘어간다.

items.title: Kaer: Security-Aware Replanning for Multi-Agent Systems
items.summary_1line: Kaer is a multi-agent framework that protects the orchestrator's replanning step from malicious agent feedback, using abstract failure templates and restricted repair operators; it is evaluated on the new Cintra benchmark against Magentic-One and ControlValve.
items.editor_note: 악의적인 에이전트 피드백으로부터 오케스트레이터의 재계획 단계를 보호하며, 새로운 Cintra 벤치마크를 함께 제시한다.

items.title: From Local Errors to System Failures: Modeling and Benchmarking Error Propagation in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
items.summary_1line: Introduces REPA, a structural model that links measured local agent responses to system-level error propagation in LLM multi-agent workflows, evaluated on ErrPropBench-10 with three Qwen base models.
items.editor_note: 개별 에이전트의 국소적 오류가 시스템 전체 실패로 전파되는 과정을 모델링하고 ErrPropBench-10에서 검증한다.

items.title: LatentLens: Rethinking Latent Interface in Multi-Agent Systems
items.summary_1line: Researchers propose LatentLens, a framework that separates the latent interface from the agent harness and tests it on seven benchmarks with Qwen3 models, finding it often fails to improve and can degrade accuracy.
items.editor_note: 부정적 결과: 잠재 공간 기반 에이전트 인터페이스는 정확도를 높이지 못하는 경우가 많고 오히려 떨어뜨릴 수 있다.

items.title: CypherMAS: Benchmarking Routing Reliability in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
items.summary_1line: Multi-agent systems (MAS) built on large language models (LLMs) distribute reasoning across specialized agents that must exchange messages and invoke tools reliably. Existing evaluations typically couple communication...
items.editor_note: 평가에서 라우팅 신뢰성과 통신을 분리한다: 메시지와 툴 호출을 각각 따로 채점한다.

items.title: Towards Realistic Evaluation of Uncertainty Quantification for LLM-Based Recommender Systems
items.summary_1line: Introduces a fixed-ranking benchmark that tests eight uncertainty quantification signals as monitors of LLM-based recommendation rankings across four datasets and two LLM backbones, reporting that method rankings shift between backbones.
items.editor_note: 관련성은 낮음: LLM 추천기의 불확실성 신호를 다루며, 공통된 표현을 기준으로 군집화한다.

items.title: Compute-Aware Submodular Online Learning in Open Multi-Agent Systems
items.summary_1line: Proposes an online policy-learning algorithm for cooperative task allocation among agents with submodular utilities that samples a fixed budget of agent-action evaluations, reporting a 1/2-approximate regret bound and experiments on information coverage.
items.editor_note: 태스크 할당에 컴퓨팅 예산을 도입한다: 라운드마다 정해진 횟수만큼 에이전트 행동을 평가한다.

items.title: Latent-in-the-Middle: On the Security of Cross-Model Latent Communication in Multi-Agent Systems
items.summary_1line: Introduces Chasm, a study of security risks in cross-model KV cache transfer between LLMs, finding transferred caches can raise prompt-injection and jailbreak success and proposing a target-side cache guard to mitigate them.
items.editor_note: 잠재 채널 문제를 보안 문제로 바꿔 본다: 전달된 KV 캐시가 인젝션과 탈옥 성공률을 높인다.

items.title: MeterRouter: Budget-Aware Dynamic Routing for Multi-Agent Systems
items.summary_1line: Presents MeterRouter, a router that builds a multi-agent collaboration graph per query under a monetary budget, reporting comparable accuracy to the strongest multi-agent system at 82% lower cost across five benchmarks.
items.editor_note: 처음으로 명시적인 달러 예산을 제시: 쿼리별 협업 그래프로 비슷한 정확도를 유지하면서 비용을 82% 줄였다.

items.title: Swarms, Flocks, Gangs: How to build, train, and evaluate multi-agent systems
items.summary_1line: A Hugging Face blog series with reproducible examples for training multi-agent systems; its first example uses four agents sharing one small model and takes about five hours on two H200s, roughly $50.
items.editor_note: 실무자가 내놓은 첫 레시피: 작은 모델 하나에 에이전트 4개를 올려 약 5시간, 대략 $50으로 학습했다.

editorial.tldr: This is a theme thread, not one event: three weeks of mostly arXiv work on what breaks when LLM agents run as a team, starting with KV-cache memory cost and orchestration. It split into security against malicious peers, tracing which agent caused a failure, and latent agent-to-agent channels that LatentLens and Chasm found unhelpful or exploitable.
editorial.whats_new: Hugging Face (Nov 26) published reproducible recipes for training multi-agent teams, the first about $50 on two H200s, a day after MeterRouter reported top multi-agent accuracy at 82% lower cost on five benchmarks.
editorial.why_it_matters: The thread has moved from what fails in agent teams to what they cost: per-query routing under a dollar budget and cheap team training make cost a tunable you can benchmark, not a fixed overhead of going multi-agent.
editorial.take_for_builders: Record per-query token cost next to accuracy in your multi-agent evals, and keep KV-cache or latent hand-offs between models behind the same injection guards as text messages until Chasm-style defenses ship.

beats.headline: Running agents as a team hits memory and orchestration limits
beats.summary: Simultaneously resident KV caches become a memory bottleneck, and harnesses that spawn worker agents get an executable orchestration benchmark.

beats.headline: Malicious peers and data leaks become the threat model
beats.summary: Private retrieval and inference, an open-source leak tester, secure aggregation rules, and a replanning step hardened against hostile agent feedback.

beats.headline: Research shifts to blaming the right agent for a failure
beats.summary: Failure attribution, collaboration repair, an error-propagation model, and a benchmark that isolates message routing and tool-call reliability.

beats.headline: Latent agent-to-agent channels: no accuracy win, new attack surface
beats.summary: LatentLens finds a latent interface often fails to help and can degrade accuracy; Chasm shows transferred KV caches raise prompt-injection and jailbreak success.

beats.headline: Cost becomes the lever: budget routing and cheap team training
beats.summary: MeterRouter builds a per-query collaboration graph under a monetary budget, compute-aware allocation samples a fixed evaluation budget, and Hugging Face ships trainable team recipes.

beats.headline: Ranking and recommender papers clustered on shared wording
beats.summary: LLM ranking at LinkedIn scale and uncertainty signals for LLM recommenders sit outside the multi-agent theme.

open_questions: Does MeterRouter's 82% cost cut hold on workloads outside its five benchmarks and at tighter budgets?
Does Chasm's target-side cache guard ship as code that KV-cache transfer stacks can adopt?
Does REPA's error-propagation model hold beyond the three Qwen base models it was evaluated on?
Do CoLFA or TRACE-MAS ship tooling that attributes failures in production agent traces, not only benchmark logs?
Does a team trained with the Hugging Face recipe beat a single larger model at equal cost on an outside benchmark?
Do CypherMAS or WorkflowArena release harnesses that teams adopt for their own regression evals?
